messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 — Canary 'checkout-v3' failing health checks in us-west1. Automated fallback to 'checkout-v2' triggered. Observed repeated sticky fallbacks and region hop for ~8min. Alerting on-call.

emma (oncall): i'm on it — seeing 5xx spike and p95 latency up ~3x for checkout flows. Is traffic still being routed to v3 at all?

raj (sre): looks like ~20% of requests hit v3 and fail, then smart-routing falls back to v2, but sticky affinity is keeping sessions pinned and then reattempts to v3 on subsequent requests -> thrash. logs show 502s from model runtime: "kv-cache-mismatch" plus OOM traces on some hosts.

chris (runtime): confirmed OOMs on host gpu-ck-v3-12 in us-west1. Model variant v3 is slightly larger exec path. Canary autoscale didn't add nodes fast enough. Also kernel selection path hitting a regression in 0.9.3 runtime.

emma (oncall): paging pager->raj and chris. can we pause the rollout and stop sticky fallback until we stabilize?

maria (product): customer impact: checkout flow timeouts observed by a handful of mid-market customers, some aborted checkouts logged — we should prepare a CS note. estimated affected sessions ~1.7% of total traffic, concentrated in us-west1.

raj (sre): manual mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout 2) disable sticky affinity for route 'checkout' 3) drain v3 hosts 4) if needed, rollback to v2. i'll coordinate.

chris (runtime): working on kernel rollback plan. immediate short-term: mark v3 unhealthy in registry to force fallback to v2 globally, but that may cause a surge. prefer pause + disable-sticky then gradual drain.

emma (oncall): executing pause: `rwctl rollout pause --rollout-id=checkout-canary-2026-03` -> response: accepted. deploy-bot: confirmed pause queued.

deploy-bot: Rollout checkout-canary-2026-03 paused by emma (oncall) at 3032109942.

raj (sre): disabling sticky affinity on route: `rwctl routing set-affinity --route=checkout --mode=none` -> applied. ops-bot: route config updated.

ops-bot: route checkout affinity: previous=sticky (TTL=300s) now=none. note: TTL caches may persist on edge for up to 60s.

chris (runtime): draining v3 hosts now: `infra/drain --pool=checkout-v3-us-west1 --grace=30s` — starting. I see autoscaler health probe regression: `/health` returns 200 for main process but model runtime returning 502 intermittently.

emma (oncall): quick health check after affinity off and drain started: error rate dropping from 15% -> 3% in the last 60s. p95 latency trending down. good sign.

maria (product): coordinating with CS — tagging customers impacted and drafting message. CC: customer-success.

customer-success: got it — will route to affected customers and provide ETA after final confirmation.

raj (sre): root cause note so far: model variant v3 uses new attention kernel path from runtime 0.9.3 which under certain sequence-length distributions runs OOM on current GPU packing. Smart-routing fallback + sticky affinity created bounce loop causing repeated cache invalidations and exacerbating load.

chris (runtime): immediate next: revert kernel selector for v3 in registry to 0.9.2 path, run a small canary internal-only validation, and then if stable re-enable rollout. timeline ~45-60m for testing + validation.

emma (oncall): action items logged: A) Pause rollout (done) B) Disable sticky affinity (done) C) Drain v3 (in progress) D) Revert kernel selector / validate (chris) E) Postmortem/ follow-up (raj+maria).

raj (sre): mitigation status: v3 pool drained to 0 active hosts in us-west1 at 3032111201, global traffic now on v2. error rate stabilized <1% for checkout flows. marking incident mitigated but not resolved.

chris (runtime): patch created to force kernel-selector=0.9.2 for checkout-v3. pushing to staging for smoke runs.

deploy-bot: patch checkout-v3 kernel-selector -> 0.9.2 created by chris at 3032111350. smoke tests kicked off.

emma (oncall): monitoring smoke: smoke tests show 0 failures across 5000 requests, latency normal. recommend controlled re-enable of canary but with sticky affinity off and autoscale headroom increased.

maria (product): strongly prefer another internal-only canary for 10 minutes before customer-facing rollout. CS still prepping customer comms.

raj (sre): agreed. schedule: internal canary -> 10m soak -> validation -> staged traffic with sticky off and autoscale target +30% headroom. I'll prep runbook updates to avoid sticky fallback during variant failures.

customer-success: update sent to impacted customers: "We've reverted checkout to the stable variant while we validate a fix. We'll follow up when the rollout resumes." will escalate individually if needed.

emma (oncall): final note: incident severity downgraded to SEV2 at 3032112200; monitoring for 1h before closing. postmortem owner: raj, due EOD + 3 action items: improve kernel-selector canary gating, add fallback cooldown to avoid immediate re-attempts, make affinity TTLs configurable per rollout.

chris (runtime): adding unit/regression test for kernel selector edge-case.

maria (product): prepping internal postmortem slide and customer-facing summary.

emma (oncall): thanks all. re-open if any regressions. :thumbsup:
